unit.note: Five roots, one pytest process each: shared/tests 6539 (44 skipped), shared/scripts/tests 345, shared/scripts/tools/tests 302, plugins/shipwright-iterate/tests 613, integration-tests 434. The 19 failures are ALL in shared/tests/test_hooks.py and are PRE-EXISTING on main: those tests subprocess.run(['bash', ...]) and bash is not on PATH in this Windows environment, so each fails with FileNotFoundError [WinError 2]. Verified by running the same file on the main checkout WITHOUT this diff - the same 19. Recorded under degraded[] rather than waved away.

surface_verification.detail: Drove the REAL record_review_pass.py CLI as a subprocess against a throwaway project, then asked the REAL F11 verifier what it made of the result - not an in-process import test. Confirmed end to end: init writes spec as an ordinary reviews key with no gates key and schema_version 1; the consumer's pinned five are all present; the gate BLOCKS while spec is unanswered even though the schema now tolerates its absence; the CLI can close spec; and a pre-promotion record carrying gates.spec still validates. 9 checks, 0 failures.

degraded.detail: 19 tests in shared/tests/test_hooks.py fail in this environment because they subprocess.run(['bash', ...]) and bash is not on PATH (FileNotFoundError, WinError 2). Confirmed PRE-EXISTING by running the same file on the main checkout without this diff - identical 19 failures. Not caused by and not related to this change. Per this repo's own silent-skip CI-discipline rule they ought to be a guarded skip locally with an install hint plus a hard failure in CI; as they stand they make every local full run look broken. Filed as a finding for a separate iterate rather than fixed here.

external_review.py --mode code returned one usable leg. openai answered 'revise' with a single finding - AC10 must be discharged in the PR rather than asserted in the spec - which duplicates Stage-2 code-review finding 3 and was accepted. The gemini leg was cut off by the provider (finish_reason=length) on a roughly 100KB diff and emitted no verdict, so the pair is not comparable. Recorded in external_code_review_state.json with explicit verdicts and a contradiction_resolution rather than left implicit.
